jobs.title: Security Guard - Calgary Only
jobs.description:
Apply before reading the following request:

1. A personal vehicle is sometimes required for certain jobs
2. The work location will be consistently on the in various parts of Calgary and it surrounding areas. Please do not apply if the distance is a concern to you;
3. Available to start a shift after a successful in-person interview.

Overview
We are seeking a dedicated and vigilant Security Guard to join our team. The ideal candidate will play a crucial role in maintaining a safe and secure environment for our clients, employees, and visitors. This position requires a proactive individual who is skilled in surveillance techniques and has a strong background in loss prevention and law enforcement.

Responsibilities
Monitor and patrol assigned areas to ensure the safety and security of the premises.
Utilize surveillance equipment, including CCTV systems, to observe activities and detect suspicious behavior.
Respond promptly to alarms and incidents, conducting investigations as necessary.
Enforce rules and regulations to maintain order within the facility.
Document incidents, prepare reports, and communicate effectively with law enforcement when required.
Provide assistance to visitors and employees while ensuring compliance with security protocols.

Experience
Previous experience in security, law enforcement, or a related field is preferred.
Familiarity with surveillance systems and loss prevention strategies is highly desirable.
Strong observational skills with the ability to remain calm under pressure.

Job Types: Full-time, Part-time, Permanent, Casual

Pay: $16.00 per hour

Benefits:
Flexible schedule
On-site parking

Licence/Certification:
Security Guard Licence (required or in process)

Work Location: In person
